title: Canonical single comparison under exact postcomposition
statement: Let C,A,B be abelian categories with derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and K-injective resolutions on C and A. Let F:C→A be additive and T:A→B be additive and exact. For M in C let cF(M):(FM)[0]→RF(M[0]) be the inverse termwise single comparison followed by the right-derived unit. Let t:T-derived((FM)[0])≅(TFM)[0] be the exact-T single comparison and let k:R(F⋙T)≅RF⋙D(T) be the canonical exact-postcomposition comparison. Then t⁻¹ followed by D(T)(cF(M)) followed by k⁻¹ at M[0] equals c(F⋙T)(M).

source.place: Tag 0AVW, lemma-affine-morphism, final pushforward identification; Tag 0AX3, remark-trace-map-finite

proof.text: Postcompose the claimed equality with k.hom. Uniqueness of right-derived functors factors the composite right-derived unit followed by k.hom into the termwise-composition comparison, the unit of RT and RT of the unit of RF. Naturality of RT≅D(T), followed by its defining unit factorization, replaces the unit of RT by the inverse exact localization comparison.

Move Q of the inverse F-single comparison through the exact localization comparison by naturality. The termwise comparison for F followed by T equals the T-single comparison followed by T of the F-single comparison: at degree zero both are the canonical object-identification maps, and away from zero both have zero source and target. Applying Q, functoriality and cancellation of k proves the equation.

theorem single_rightDerived_exact_composition (F : C ⥤ A) (T : A ⥤ B)
    [F.Additive] [T.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits T] [PreservesFiniteColimits T]
    (M : C) :
    (T.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).inv.app (F.obj M) ≫
      T.mapDerivedCategory.map
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex F (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).inv.app M) ≫
          F.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj
            ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).obj M))) ≫
      (rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso F T).inv.app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj M) =
    DerivedCategory.Q.map
      ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex (F ⋙ T)
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).inv.app M) ≫
      (F ⋙ T).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj
        ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).obj M))
